verdict.rationale: Orb has some bulk-style data handling: event backfills replay historical usage at scale, and managed daily exports send resource types to a destination. Cursor-based pagination and multi-language SDKs make scripted iteration over many resources possible. However, Subscription Edits are explicitly scoped to a single subscription, and there is no documented bulk or batch endpoint for mutating many items (subscriptions, invoices, customers) at once. Missing for 10: bulk/batch mutation endpoints or UI bulk actions, explicit batch API semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
